remarks: Stunning views from this open concept, extra large 1 bedroom, PLUS LARGE loft, 1 full bath corner PENTHOUSE unit, overlooking a very attractive, professionally landscaped courtyard. VAULTED ceilings in living room, great storage and large rooms with large walk in closets in both primary bedroom and loft. Extra large balcony off of living room. The well appointed eat in kitchen offers beautiful granite counters, GE stainless steel appliances, an expansive island that doubles as a full size breakfast bar. There is a full size laundry set in unit, with extra storage in closet. Building amenities include access to a fitness center, the spacious courtyard that offers gas grills and seating, covered garage parking, meeting room, concierge, two elevator access points and is all very conveniently just steps away from local transportation and minutes from Metro North commuter train, Chelsea Piers, trendy restaurants, shops, beach, boating, tennis, and golf with easy access to I-95, Greenwich, Darien, Norwalk & Westport. Unit is in terrific condition, and ready for its new owners!
